name: Mindful Egg
tagline: A cosy Roblox game where journaling, breathing and stretching help an egg and its world grow.
problem: Self-care is talked about but rarely practised consistently, especially by students.
solution: Habit actions feed a growth loop for an egg and its environment, with simple UI and progression.
demo_moment: Team-described: complete a breathing exercise and watch the egg grow.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Gives an abstract habit immediate visible feedback.

lessons: Visible progress turns a habit into a game loop.
